name: Ivaris
source:
Ivaris is a red Om'veri with black wing membranes and horns curved like sickles. As a scientist, Ivaris wears a protective black suit on his body and dark goggles on his head.
Ivaris is a self-doubting, failed scientist whose home is plagued by constant explosions from botched experiments. In terms of character and ambition, he borders on the status of a mad scientist. Despite his eccentric nature, Ivaris has a kind heart and dreams of his inventions becoming a public asset. He is a poor cook due to issues with his fire breath, and he has a habit of stuttering.
